en.t: The meal was still eaten beneath the large umbrella.

units.source_text: 汤煮蔬菜加上烤干鱼……每样都带有一点沙子的味道。

en.t: Soup-boiled vegetables and dried grilled fish... everything carried a slight taste of sand.

units.source_text: 他想，要是把伞吊在天花板上的话，女人也可以一起坐下来吃饭了，

en.t: He thought that if the umbrella were hung from the ceiling, the woman could sit down and eat with him too,

units.source_text: 可他实在没有特邀她一起用餐的心情。

en.t: but he really was not in the mood to make a special invitation for her to share the meal.

units.source_text: 粗茶，颜色挺黑，却淡而无味。

en.t: The coarse tea was quite dark in color, yet weak and tasteless.
